@'
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict
from scripts.knowledge.curate import CARD_ID,curate_card,read_json
root=Path.cwd()
base=read_json(root/'artifacts/phase2/s11/preservation-before.json')
changed=[]
for f in base['files']:
 p=root/f['path']; data=p.read_bytes()
 if len(data)!=f['bytes'] or hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=f['sha256']: changed.append(f['path'])
draft=curate_card(CARD_ID,root/'content/phase2-healthy-v1/review-inputs.json')
assert asdict(draft)==read_json(root/'content/phase2-healthy-v1-bundle/card-draft.json')
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'scripts/knowledge/publish.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8')
v=json.loads(r.stdout)
assert r.returncode==2 and not r.stderr
assert v['status']=='needs_check' and (v['claims'],v['sources'],v['lesson_ids'])==([],[],[])
assert v['reasons']==['source_review_pending','translation_review_pending','rights_scope_review_pending','publication_not_authorized','positive_publisher_unimplemented']
assert not changed
print(json.dumps({'protected_files':len(base['files']),'changed':changed,'draft_reproduced':True,'cli_exit':r.returncode,'cli':v},ensure_ascii=False))
'@ | .venv-phase0/Scripts/python.exe -
